name: Impactive (formerly Outvote)
long_description:
Impactive, backed by YCombinator and Higher Ground Labs, was founded in 2017 as a get-out-the-vote tool for Democrats. The Impactive product has since expanded to become a full-service platform allowing any campaign or cause to engage in distributed organizing.

In the 2018 midterms, volunteers contacted over 1 million voters using Impactive. In 2020, we scaled significantly to meet the demand of this unprecedented election cycle. We’ve worked with over 500 clients nationwide, and volunteers have sent over 100 million text messages on behalf of Planned Parenthood, the DCCC, SEIU, Community Change, When We All Vote, Greenpeace, and campaigns up and down the ballot. Our work has been featured in The New York Times, Washington Post, TechCrunch, Fast Company, and many more.

In 2021, Impactive will expand its platform further into nonprofit, advocacy, and additional markets. This will be an exciting time to play a critical role in helping shape the direction for what’s coming next. We will continue to prioritize our progressive values while building a feature-rich platform that will broaden our reach across the impact space.
one_liner: Political/civic tech helping progressive campaigns organize & mobilize

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Naseem (he/him) is the founder of Outvote–a digital organizing platform for campaigns and causes. Outvote empowers volunteers to organize the people they know via text, email, and social media. Outvote then connects that work to the infrastructure of major campaigns and national organizations that have been doing similar work for decades. When he isn't pitching or writing code, Naseem can be found being a foodie with his wife, Pennylynn, and going on long walks with his dog, Lucy.

name: AnnieCannons
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
long_description: AnnieCannons' mission is to train, prepare, and connect human trafficking survivors of sustainable careers in tech. Through a trauma-informed coding and workforce development program, AnnieCannons trains survivors to become professional software developers and AI engineers and places them in paid apprenticeships with partner companies through a model that converts at over 80%, with median starting salaries of $75,000 or more. The program is tailored for people who have faced compounded barriers including poverty, housing insecurity, interrupted education, and trauma across multiple systems.
one_liner: Connecting Survivors to Careers in Tech

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Laura Hackney is a human rights advocate and full-stack software engineer from Atlanta, GA. She is the CEO and Cofounder of AnnieCannons, a national organization dedicated to training, preparing, and connecting individuals who have experienced human trafficking to sustainable careers in tech. Prior to AnnieCannons, Laura managed the Program on Human Rights at Stanford University’Freeman Spogli Institute. She also worked as the Senior Research Associate for Stanford’s Anti-Trafficking Project.

name: Recidiviz
long_description:
Recidiviz is a non-profit technology company that drives meaningful changes in criminal justice systems and improved outcomes for justice-impacted individuals.

Criminal justice data today is inefficient and ineffective: researchers, advocates, policymakers and practitioners each need funding and time for data collection and cleaning (for almost any data at all), and most data collected is too stale by the time it’s compiled to be useful.

Recidiviz has built an open-source platform to ingest data from across data silos, link it, standardize it, and expose it in usable formats to the ecosystem. We provide products and analyses on top of this platform to help government agencies understand how their justice systems are functioning, set and track progress towards goals, drive evidence-based improvements to practice and policy, and ensure justice-impacted folks reenter their communities as safely and quickly as they can.
one_liner: Helping create a smaller, fairer, safer justice system

launches.title: Ontra Mobility - Increasing ridership for transit agencies
launches.body:
**tldr:** [Ontra](https://www.ontramobility.com/) helps cities and transit agencies increase ridership through data-driven planning and real-time optimization.

# **🚀 Introduction**

Hey everyone! We’re Anthony and Connor, aka the [Ontra Mobility](https://www.ontramobility.com/) team, and we’re revolutionizing how people move.

## **❗ The Problem**

Transit agencies in the U.S. are facing massive budget shortfalls (up to $3B). Agencies need to adapt their transit systems more quickly to meet the demands of our evolving cities. Work from home led to a large drop in ridership, which is problematic for train and bus routes, which have high fixed costs. Cutting lines or reducing frequency further impacts ridership - transit agencies need a different solution.

## **💡 The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83029&key=user_uploads/1627714/d71e126f-1b4c-4fa4-b902-3e1e5f0e05bd)

Ontra helps cities and other transit agencies increase ridership through data-driven planning and real-time optimization. Our platform optimizes cost and rider experience by designing high-frequency bus routes and ridesharing zones, where our algorithms adapt routes to demand in real time.

## **⚙️ How It Works**

Ontra analyzes information about where people live, how they've traveled in the past, and the existing transit system to figure out the best way to redesign the transit network.

Once the improvements are made, Ontra Mobility plans rider journeys in real-time with the best combination of transit options available, whether it’s a train, bus, bike, or agency-operated on-demand. Our system can handle thousands of ridesharing requests per minute – efficiently assigning riders to optimal routes.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B-RyHtEurVk>

## **🚌 What’s New**

* Our transit network design application generates bus routes and micro-transit zones
* Seamless multimodal journeys – our algorithm synchronizes transfers between on-demand and fixed-route

## **🎓 The Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83029&key=user_uploads/1627714/00845b02-7e5c-42c7-9f3a-d28399c6f6eb)

Anthony and Connor are both former Google engineers with PhDs in [operations](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=XZ4e0UwAAAAJ&hl=en) [research](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=z3j6J0cAAAAJ&hl=en). Prior to joining YC, they worked on [MARTA Reach](https://itsmarta.com/reach.aspx) in Atlanta, GA, and [CAT Smart](https://catchacat.org/smart/) in Savannah, GA.

## **🙏 Ask: How you can help**

* Connect us to private- or public- **transit agency employees** or **board members**, **politicians,** and **transit advocates**. [founders@ontramobility.com](mailto:founders@ontramobility.com)

name: Rescript
long_description:
Rescript is using AI to make the law transparent, accessible, and easy to act on. Laws and regulations differ across jurisdictions and are constantly changing, making them too complex for organizations to review and track manually at scale. We're building an agentic AI platform capable of aggregating and interpreting global regulations, tracking how they change, and identifying how organizations should respond. 

Our customers span AmLaw100 law firms, Fortune 100 corporations, and top trade associations across healthcare, retail, fintech and more. They depend on Rescript to help them comply with and act on an ever-changing regulatory landscape from the federal level down to individual cities.  

We're backed by YC, General Catalyst, and Floodgate.
one_liner: AI for Legal & Public Policy Teams

launches.title: Rescript — AI Regulatory Analyst for Enterprises
launches.tagline: We track emerging policies and create well-researched compliance and advocacy materials.
launches.body:
**Tl;dr:** [Rescript](https://rescript.ai/) helps regulatory compliance and advocacy teams monitor, analyze, and act on the never-ending stream of regulatory and political developments.

**Problem:** 

Regulatory lawyers and lobbyists guide companies through constantly changing legal and political environments and are paid tens of billions of dollars every year to do so.

But there’s too much to track manually: to identify any new risk or opportunity in the US alone, they have to monitor 150,000+ laws introduced, 300,000+ hours of government hearings, and thousands of new regulations and enforcement suits every year.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83747&key=user_uploads/912498/4e8e332c-8c30-49ec-a086-b4e6099706e6)

**Solution:**

Rescript automates this process from end to end. We’ve built AI agents that scrape legislation and regulation as it changes, identify what’s relevant for you, and help you create well-researched compliance and advocacy materials.

1. **Exhaustive Tracking:** Rescript’s AI Agents scan the web and create detailed analyses of everything you need, including hearings, regulations, news, and press releases.  
2. **Intelligent Filtering:** Our tool uses human-like reasoning to determine if a new development involves the user’s policy issues. No more dealing with keywords. 
3. **Personalized Analysis:** Collaborate with AI to translate regulatory updates into actionable insights for internal business and compliance teams.

**The Team:** 

[Nikhil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikhil-ajjarapu/) previously worked as a consultant for the DoD and built software for major federal agencies with Salesforce’s Public Sector team. He graduated magna cum laude from Princeton, where he studied Computer Science and earned minors in History & Public Policy.

[Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alex-pesendorfer/) previously worked in software engineering at a leading derivatives marketplace. He graduated summa cum laude from Princeton with a BSE in Computer Science and minors in Statistics, Machine Learning, and Finance.

[Vince](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vincentjh/) holds an MS in Computer Science and a BA in Philosophy from Stanford and previously staffed the House Science Committee in Congress.

**Working with us**

Rescript is already used by top-10-ranked government relations firms and AmLaw 200 law firms.

If you’re interested in learning more, please [schedule a time with us here for a 15-minute demo](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ2QGC5HMWdnOcDcz1cPXamWS8qKzQWFktlQLupOBtY50W-JOfXsHabKGx6u7Nod59taBnm7-dYe), or message us at [team@rescript.ai](mailto:team@rescript.ai).
